what: From integrate-docs (found by its children, read from code, not run): (1) cache-key hole: BLAZE_EMIT changes LLVM output but is in neither hir-ty-codegen/v2/backend.rs CHANGES_CODE nor any unit key, so code kept under one value is reused under the other. (2) possible stale code identity: hir_ty_share::code via hir-ty-codegen/v2/hashes.rs takes callees by interface hash and does not include the __blaze_cache_code constant, so a function asking for its cached closure code may keep a stale hash after an edit to code the closure reaches (v1 recompiled via patch.rs cached_roots; docs/fn-cache.md). (3) tests_reach in hir-ty-codegen/fncache.rs has no v2 caller: delete or wire (docs/cargo.md calls hermetic tests v1).

history.note: All three: (1) BLAZE_EMIT added to CHANGES_CODE in v2/backend.rs, so a v2 unit refuses while it is set, like BLAZE_OPT. (2) fncache::written_code gives what a cached function instance writes for its body (the cache_code hash or why not); v2/frontend.rs code_of mixes it into the code hash of a cached function, so an edit below its closure is new code; test a_cached_function_is_new_code_when_what_its_closure_reaches_is in v2/tests.rs. (3) tests_reach is already gone (only doc mentions remain).
